id: title:Z3r0Sum:publish ordered release aliases for posthog cloud

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow configuration for publishing Docker image aliases to AWS ECR, supporting the PostHog release and deployment pipeline.
review.reason: The chunk consists of a single workflow file with configuration and a new job. P1.F1.H3 replaces a hardcoded repository with an environment variable, P1.F1.H2 sets that variable, and P1.F1.H1 adds the necessary outputs. P1.F1.H7 adds the new job. This is a maintenance and configuration change to the CI/CD pipeline.
review.uncertainty: This score does not account for the actual adoption or benefit of the new image alias feature, only the implementation of the workflow configuration. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.
